questions.text: You have two free café hours today. What should they feel like?

options.label: A quiet corner for reading, studying, or light focus
Plants everywhere, soft sun, easy to sit for ages
Warm lamps, soft chairs, perfect for a date or heart talk
Friends around, photos looking good, the mood turns brighter

questions.text: What is sitting on your ideal café table?

options.label: A half-open book, an easy drink, and slower music
A clean table, simple menu, and quick ordering
A camera, cute cake, and props for playful shots
A little plant, a stripe of sun, ice melting slowly

questions.text: You open the café door. Which sound says yes?

options.label: Soft keyboard taps, everyone gently focused
Leaves moving, ice touching glass, air feeling fresh
An old record, café hum, the day slowing down
Friends laughing just loud enough, playlist lifting the mood

questions.text: What makes a café feel cute to you?

options.label: Warm light, a small table, no rush to leave
Plants and a nearby walk after coffee
Pretty check-in corners, flattering light, stories for the group
Not too showy, comfortable even when you go solo

questions.text: If rain suddenly arrives, what kind of café do you want to hide in?

options.label: Dry, quiet, with a table that stays comfortable
Window seat, rain outside, greenery in view
Warm light, a small dessert, talking until it clears
A big table, friends arriving, rain becoming the excuse

questions.text: How do you usually choose your drink?

options.label: Something simple, easy to drink, quick to grab
A mood-matching drink that looks fun and tastes easy
A familiar drink that feels honest and close
A cool, light drink made for lingering

questions.text: If you take one photo there, what should it feel like?

options.label: A cute table, pretty drink, clear modern light
Sun through leaves, gentle greens, room to breathe
A little film-like, a little old, slower Saigon
A check-in with friends, natural, fun, and memorable
A solo selfie with good light and a clear mood
A group photo with friends, fun and memorable right away

questions.text: The café has many empty seats. Which one do you pick first?

options.label: A wall-side corner, low traffic, easy to focus
Near plants or a small patio, some breeze if possible
A soft chair, warm light, comfortable for longer talks
A larger table, useful for friends or spreading things out

questions.text: Which café hour fits you best?

options.label: Early morning, just opened, a quick mood reset
Late morning, good sun, a gentle reset
Golden hour, pretty light, good for dates or photos
Late enough to be calm, with stories slowing down

questions.text: How do you want to spend on coffee today?

options.label: Friendly price, still fine for sitting quietly a while
A little more is fine if the date feels worth it
As long as the space feels good to stay in
With a group, shared bill and good mood are enough

questions.text: If today's café plan needs a good photo, what kind of check-in do you want?

options.label: A solo selfie with good light, bright and a little playful
A group photo corner where friends instantly look fun together

cozy-plant-corner.title: Cozy Plant Corner
cozy-plant-corner.subtitle: A small green corner where the day softens.
cozy-plant-corner.description: You fit cafés with nearby greenery, gentle light, and a slower pace. Sitting down should make the day soften without asking much from you.
cozy-plant-corner.shareDescription: My café persona: plants, breathing room, and a gentle reset.

quiet-city-window.title: Quiet City Window
quiet-city-window.subtitle: The city moves, your rhythm stays yours.
quiet-city-window.description: You need a good window, soft street noise, and a tidy table. Not away from the city, just quietly above its rush.
quiet-city-window.shareDescription: My café persona: window light, soft city, clear head.

lively-friends-table.title: Lively Friends Table
lively-friends-table.subtitle: People, stories, and mood arriving fast.
lively-friends-table.description: Coffee is best with a wide table, easy laughter, and a playlist that gives the group momentum. The right café lets conversation run on its own.
lively-friends-table.shareDescription: My café persona: friends at the table, mood instantly up.

late-night-work.title: Late Night Deadline Owl
late-night-work.subtitle: Night falls, laptop open, coffee keeping you in flow.
late-night-work.description: You fit cafés that stay tidy, quiet, powered, and focused enough for late work. No drama, just a room that helps the task start.
late-night-work.shareTitle: I am Late Night Deadline Owl
late-night-work.shareDescription: My café persona: laptop open, night falling, work still moving.

vintage-tea-nostalgia.title: Vintage Tea Nostalgia
vintage-tea-nostalgia.subtitle: Tea aroma, old wood, stories slowing down.
vintage-tea-nostalgia.description: You are drawn to old wood, warm tea, and familiar texture. The right café makes every little detail feel like it has memory.
vintage-tea-nostalgia.shareDescription: My café persona: vintage corners, warm tea, slower time.

sunny-iced-coffee.title: Sunny Iced Coffee
sunny-iced-coffee.subtitle: Bright, cool, easy like ice slowly melting.
sunny-iced-coffee.description: You fit cafés with pretty sun, cool drinks, and a day-brightening mood. Fresh, simple, and easy to enjoy.
sunny-iced-coffee.shareDescription: My café persona: good sun, iced coffee, brighter mood.

lazy-afternoon-nap.title: Lazy Afternoon Nap
lazy-afternoon-nap.subtitle: Soft chairs, low noise, time melting slowly.
lazy-afternoon-nap.description: You need soft seating, gentle light, and no pressure to leave. Sometimes the perfect café is permission to be lazily restored.
lazy-afternoon-nap.shareDescription: My café persona: soft chair, slow afternoon, easy mood.

deadline-chaos.title: Deadline Chaos
deadline-chaos.subtitle: When it is urgent, the table and caffeine must keep up.
deadline-chaos.description: You can handle fast energy when the café is useful: wide table, stable wifi, quick orders, and enough buzz to drag the deadline across the line.
deadline-chaos.shareDescription: My café persona: slightly messy, very caffeinated, get it done.

aesthetic-latte-shot.title: Aesthetic Latte Shot
aesthetic-latte-shot.subtitle: Pretty cup, pretty light, a photo with a story.
aesthetic-latte-shot.description: You fit cafés with good light, camera-friendly drinks, and details that feel intentional. Coffee is also a way to save the mood of the day.
aesthetic-latte-shot.shareDescription: My café persona: pretty latte, lovely light, real vibe.

neon-wall-selfie.title: Neon Wall Selfie
neon-wall-selfie.subtitle: One mirror shot, one neon glow, instant mood.
neon-wall-selfie.description: You fit cafés with a bold wall, a good mirror, and playful light. Coffee should give you a corner where the photo feels bright, natural, and a little cheeky.
neon-wall-selfie.shareDescription: My café persona: mirror selfie, neon wall, photo with mood.

friends-photo-corner.title: Friends Photo Corner
friends-photo-corner.subtitle: The group steps in, the memory already has a frame.
friends-photo-corner.description: You fit cafés with a roomy photo spot, kind light, and enough fun energy for the group to relax. The right café leaves everyone with a photo worth keeping.
friends-photo-corner.shareDescription: My café persona: friends together, easy photo corner, saved memory.

slow-tea-time.title: Slow Tea Time
slow-tea-time.subtitle: Warm, gentle, private enough for stories.
slow-tea-time.description: You fit cafés with warm light, fragrant tea, and a pace slow enough for long conversation. Soft, close, and never too showy.
slow-tea-time.shareDescription: My café persona: slow tea, warm light, long talks.
avoidWhen: it is too loud to hear

cafe-hopping.title: Cafe Hopping
cafe-hopping.subtitle: One café is not enough; the next stop is part of the mood.
cafe-hopping.description: You like cafés with a distinct point of view, convenient next stops, and something new to notice. Coffee is a tiny route, not just a seat.
cafe-hopping.shareDescription: My café persona: try somewhere new, move on, save another address.

quiet-reading-nook.title: Quiet Reading Nook
quiet-reading-nook.subtitle: A small corner, open pages, the world turned down.
quiet-reading-nook.description: You fit very quiet cafés with readable light and seating comfortable enough to stay. The right room lets every page slow down.
quiet-reading-nook.shareDescription: My café persona: open book, quiet corner, warm coffee.
